definitions.explanation: Relating to translation or reference from English to Japanese, especially for dictionaries.

examples.japanese: {英和|えいわ}{辞典|じてん}を{使|つか}う。
{英和|えいわ}{翻訳|ほんやく}のアルバイトをしている。
examples.english: I have a part-time job doing English-Japanese translation.

examples.japanese: {大|おお}きい{英和|えいわ}{辞典|じてん}が{欲|ほ}しい。
examples.english: I want a big English-Japanese dictionary.

notes:
USAGE: Most commonly used with {辞典|じてん}/{辞書|じしょ} (dictionary) to refer to English-Japanese dictionaries.

DICTIONARY TYPES:
・{英和|えいわ}{辞典|じてん} (English-Japanese dictionary)
・{和英|わえい}{辞典|じてん} (Japanese-English dictionary)
・{漢和|かんわ}{辞典|じてん} (Chinese character-Japanese dictionary)
・{国語|こくご}{辞典|じてん} (Japanese dictionary)

PATTERN: {Language A}{Language B} = A to B direction
